name: CapillaryMindlinPhysDelaunay
description: An extended version of ̀(iPhysType), adding capillary data for CapillarityEngine.

attributes.name: meniscus
attributes.description: Presence of a meniscus if true

attributes.name: isBroken
attributes.description: If true, capillary force is zero and liquid bridge is inactive.

attributes.name: computeBridge
attributes.description: If true, capillary bridge will be computed if not it will be ignored.

attributes.name: capillaryPressure
attributes.description: Value of the capillary pressure Uc defines as Ugas-Uliquid

attributes.name: vMeniscus
attributes.description: Volume of the menicus

attributes.name: Delta1
attributes.description: Defines the surface area wetted by the meniscus on the smallest grains of radius R1 (R1<R2)

attributes.name: Delta2
attributes.description: Defines the surface area wetted by the meniscus on the biggest grains of radius R2 (R1<R2)

attributes.name: fCap
attributes.description: Capillary Force produces by the presence of the meniscus

attributes.name: SInterface
attributes.description: Fluid-Gaz Interfacial area

attributes.name: arcLength
attributes.description: Arc Length of the Fluid-Gaz Interface

attributes.name: fusionNumber
attributes.description: Indicates the number of meniscii that overlap with this one

attributes.name: kno
attributes.description: Constant value in the formulation of the normal stiffness

attributes.name: kso
attributes.description: Constant value in the formulation of the tangential stiffness

attributes.name: maxBendPl
attributes.description: Coefficient to determine the maximum plastic moment to apply at the contact

attributes.name: normalViscous
attributes.description: Normal viscous component

attributes.name: shearViscous
attributes.description: Shear viscous component

attributes.name: shearElastic
attributes.description: Total elastic shear force

attributes.name: usElastic
attributes.description: Total elastic shear displacement (only elastic part)

attributes.name: usTotal
attributes.description: Total elastic shear displacement (elastic+plastic part)

attributes.name: momentBend
attributes.description: Artificial bending moment to provide rolling resistance in order to account for some degree of interlocking between particles

attributes.name: momentTwist
attributes.description: Artificial twisting moment (no plastic condition can be applied at the moment)

attributes.name: radius
attributes.description: Contact radius (only computed with

attributes.name: adhesionForce
attributes.description: Force of adhesion as predicted by DMT

attributes.name: isAdhesive
attributes.description: bool to identify if the contact is adhesive, that is to say if the contact force is attractive

attributes.name: isSliding
attributes.description: check if the contact is sliding (useful to calculate the ratio of sliding contacts)

attributes.name: betan
attributes.description: Normal Damping Ratio. Fraction of the viscous damping coefficient (normal direction) equal to $ frac{c_{n}}{C_{n,crit}}$.

attributes.name: betas
attributes.description: Shear Damping Ratio. Fraction of the viscous damping coefficient (shear direction) equal to $ frac{c_{s}}{C_{s,crit}}$.

attributes.name: beta
attributes.description: Auxiliary parameter used in the viscous damping model of (Mueller2011)

attributes.name: prevU
attributes.description: Previous local displacement; only used with

attributes.name: Fs
attributes.description: Shear force in local axes (computed incrementally)

attributes.name: initD
attributes.description: initial penetration distance, used for crackaperture estimate

attributes.name: kr
attributes.description: rotational stiffness [N.m/rad]

attributes.name: ktw
attributes.description: twist stiffness [N.m/rad]

attributes.name: tangensOfFrictionAngle
attributes.description: tan of angle of friction

attributes.name: frictDissip
attributes.description: frictional energy dissipation in the contact (this value is updated by contact laws applicable to FrictPhys - currently only

attributes.name: ks
attributes.description: Shear stiffness

attributes.name: shearForce
attributes.description: Shear force after previous step (in global coordinates), as sustained by particle #2 (from particle #1).

attributes.name: kn
attributes.description: Normal stiffness

attributes.name: normalForce
attributes.description: Normal force after previous step (in global coordinates), as sustained by particle #2 (from particle #1).

attributes.name: dispIndex
attributes.description: Return class index of this instance.

methods.name: dispHierarchy
methods.description: Return list of dispatch classes (from down upwards), starting with the class instance itself, top-level indexable at last. If names is true (default), return class names rather than numerical indices.

methods.name: updateAttrs
methods.description: Update object attributes from given dictionary
